title: The map of the values' prints
description: examples/out/values/index.json, schema 1.0 (spec 2026-10-24-onglet-commandes-pages, REQ-005, ARCH-004, ARCH-009) -- where each value of each argument with values of each command's page (calc/i18n/command-pages.json) stands in the sheet of its command and language, examples/out/values/<lang>-<command>.png. Written whole by calc/tools/build_examples.py's render_values, never by hand; read by calc/tools/command_page.py (the commands tab and the website cut the sheet at `rect`) and held by tests/test_command_values.py: every rectangle inside its sheet's size, every value of every page present in each language, its hash the hash of the call the page writes now.

ppi.description: The resolution the calls were compiled at.

scale.description: What a bubble shows a print at: 0.6 of its pixels.

sheets.description: By `<lang>-<command>`, its sheet: the file, its size in pixels [width, height], the hash of its values' calls (a sheet whose hash is unchanged is not compiled again), and whether each value was compiled as a document of its own (always, ARCH-010).

values.description: By `<command>|<argument>|<value as Typst writes it>`, by language: the hash of its call (value_hash), its rectangle in the sheet [top, width, height] -- absent where nothing is printed (`blank`) --, the hash of its ink, and the other values of the same argument whose print is the same (`same`).
